subject.title: fix(tlon): bound urbit scry JSON response reads

question: Should Tlon scry success responses adopt the shared 16 MiB fail-closed JSON cap after preserving path diagnostics and adding real-path proof?
rationale: The helper is the right hardening layer, but applying the cap changes behavior for any legitimate Tlon scry JSON body above 16 MiB and needs owner acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept Shared Cap With Path Diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the failing scry path in the helper label and tests, require changed-path proof, and then accept the shared cap for Tlon scry.

options.title: Choose A Tlon-Specific Limit
options.body: Ask for an explicit larger Tlon cap if maintainers know valid scry payloads exceed the shared provider JSON budget.

options.title: Defer To Broader Sweep
options.body: Pause this focused PR only if maintainers want one coordinated decision with the broader response-bounding work despite that branch currently being conflicting.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Cap With Path Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve the failing scry path in the helper label and tests, require changed-path proof, and then accept the shared cap for Tlon scry.
